managerSummary: SCORE MEANING: 7.6 is not a quality rating of the payroll module. It is the share of the audit's 55 findings this repository can account for - 42 of 55. It measures the RECORD, not the code. The Automated Payroll audit ran 10-12 September 2026 and numbered 55 findings. 39 are fixed with evidence anyone can check - a test, a code comment, or a merged pull request. 2 more (30 and 36) are claimed closed by earlier work that is not named anywhere. 1 (finding 19) is mentioned only in passing and was never fixed or dismissed. And 13 - findings 1, 6 to 13, 21, 24, 25 and 28 - appear nowhere at all: not in the code, not in a test, not in git history, not in any pull request. They are unaccounted for rather than open. The audit document that assigned these numbers and rated their severity was never saved into this repository, which is why those 13 cannot be reconstructed from it. The severity counts below are recorded only where a merged pull request stated one in words (3 High, 13 Medium); the rest were never rated in anything this repository holds, and the counts are therefore a floor, not a total. The finding-by-finding record is the ledger file.

topBusinessRisks.businessImpact: Nobody can say whether findings 1, 6-13, 21, 24, 25 and 28 were fixed, dismissed, folded into another finding, or dropped. If any of them touched money, the defect may still be live and nobody is looking for it.
topBusinessRisks.requiredAction: Recover the original audit document from outside this repository and reconcile it against the ledger. Record the outcome of each of the thirteen, whatever it turns out to be.
